identity: A comic strip for children - Abu al-Zurafa, screenplay by al-Mansi Qandil, art by Najib Farah. Three credit lines, then a caption (wa-fi al-manzil) and a run of speech balloons: a teacher sets an essay on how war breaks out, the boy asks his father for help, and the parents fall into exactly the quarrel that answers the question. One printed line = one credit field, one caption, or one speech balloon. Median line 6 tokens.
law: Mostly LINE MODE (checklist v3 PASS 0: median under 10). Credits are M1 - each credit line is ONE unit, no splitting of sinaryu al-Mansi Qandil or rusum Najib Farah. The caption wa-fi al-manzil is its own unit. For the balloons I applied 0g-bis PER LINE rather than by document median: a balloon of 8 tokens or fewer is one unit; a balloon of 9-14 tokens gets a cut only where a genuinely SECOND SPEECH ACT starts. A balloon is a turn, not a verse line, and a turn can hold two sentences - but only two, and only when the second is a different act (exclamation then statement, statement then hortative/imperative, statement then prediction).
reasoning: Seven internal cuts, each one a change of speech act inside one balloon. @73 and @109 are the same balloon opener twice - kalam farigh (nonsense!) is a bare exclamation and the argument that follows it is a separate sentence; 0s binds me to treat the two copies identically, and I did. @90 amuka ala haqq kama hiya al-ada then li-nabhath an mathal akhar - a verdict followed by a proposal. @187 kafa khalas then atiqid annani fahimtu - an exclamation followed by the punchline. @48 wa-yafham fi kull shay then sawfa yusaiduni bi-l-takid - a fact followed by a prediction; @59 is the fathers mirror of it (mawdu sahl jiddan then sawfa usaiduka bi-l-takid) and I cut it too for the same 0s reason, though its balloon is only 7 tokens, which is why I marked it lo. @166 anti la tafhamin siwa fi al-tabkh then the imperative utruki al-siyasa - borderline at exactly 8 tokens, also lo. Everything else I refused: @32 wa-la adri and @140 wa-ma huwa al-sawab are wa-coordinations inside one sentence; @122 wa-lakin (0q, and the balloon is 5 tokens); @128 idhan fa-anta is a single accusation; @174 wa-la al-siyasa is a bare-noun coordination. The teachers 14-token instruction @11-@24 is ONE unit - an instruction block is never shredded (J6/J3, and 1h @153 where the poem instruction stayed whole) - even though it contains the essay title kayfa tandali al-harb, which appears again alone at @96-@98 as the boys own line and is a unit there because the line makes it one. 169 real tokens over 33 units = 5.1 per unit, which is the line-mode profile this document should have.
